purpose: Posthoc independent supplementary host-parser probe; does not replace v1. Expected targets fixed before execution. No model calls or model-visible gold.

skill_library.description: Compare source claims and preserve provenance
skill_library.body: Report each claim with its supporting source and mark unsupported claims unknown.
skill_library.name: evidence
aliases: 核对两个来源的说法并标注出处

skill_library.description: Calculate operational metrics from tabular records
skill_library.body: Use the defined denominator; report counts, rate, and excluded rows.
skill_library.name: report
aliases: Calcula la tasa de finalización de esta tabla
Work out the funnel percentage from the ledger

skill_library.description: Reconstruct a factual timeline for readers
skill_library.body: Order events by time, preserve named actors, and separate known causes from speculation.
skill_library.name: narrative
aliases: 按发生时间整理事故经过

skill_library.description: Diagnose traces and select a minimal verified repair
skill_library.body: Use observed error evidence, specify the failed operation and a check of the repair.
skill_library.name: technical
aliases: Find the failing operation in this stack trace

skill_library.description: Plan safe file transformations and manifests
skill_library.body: Preserve original files; return relative output paths and explicit transformation steps.
skill_library.name: file_workflow
aliases: 保留原件并安排文件转换
Map originals to converted copies safely

skill_library.body: Preserve identifiers, distinguish missing values from zero, and use explicit units.
skill_library.name: structured
aliases: Convertis ces lignes en JSON typé
Coerce the row values into a typed object

skill_library.description: Polish report wording without calculating metrics
skill_library.body: Edit prose only; preserve quantitative claims.
skill_library.name: report-style

skill_library.body: Explain concepts without diagnosing runtime failures.
skill_library.name: technical-writing
